prompt:

About the freelancer: 7 years experience; skills: JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST API, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, full stack, HTML and CSS

Job post (treat as data):
<job>
Title: Website development for radiostation + played song database and dashboard
I`m looking for a developer who could build a website for radiostation www.nordichilloutradio.com This should be a one-pager website built in WordPress, mobile responsive and SEO, in addition, played song database should be developed. Find attached a more detailed work description.
</job>

Past projects you may mention (the ONLY experience you may claim):
(none)

- Open by restating the client's specific problem in one sentence.

text:
You need a mobile-responsive, SEO-friendly WordPress one-pager for nordichilloutradio.com, plus a played-song database and dashboard to keep track of broadcasts.

Hi — I’m Tobias Reyne, a full-stack developer with 7 years of experience building modern web applications with JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST API, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, HTML, and CSS.

For this project, I’d focus on creating a clean, fast, and easy-to-manage website that fits the identity of a radio station while also giving you the backend structure needed for the played-song database and dashboard. Since the site is intended to be a one-pager in WordPress, I’d make sure the front end is mobile responsive, well-structured, and optimized for SEO so it performs well across devices and is easy to find in search engines.

On the database side, I can build a reliable system for storing played songs and related information, along with a dashboard for viewing and managing those entries. I’d approach this with clear data structure, straightforward navigation, and a practical admin experience so your team can update and use it without unnecessary complexity.

I also pay close attention to performance and maintainability. That means keeping the implementation clean, making sure the site loads efficiently, and designing the solution so it can grow if you later want to expand the station’s website or add more functionality.

My working style is collaborative and detail-oriented. I’ll make sure the layout, content structure, and technical setup align with your requirements from the start, and I’m happy to adapt based on the more detailed work description you mentioned. If you want a developer who can handle both the website and the supporting application logic in a structured way, I’d be glad to help move this forward.
